normativeText: Paraphrases and acceptance policies only; no normative quotations or members-only text.
evidenceNotice: References identify tests; execution and coverage evidence come from test-run results.

planProvenance.notice: The original f029 revision was not recovered. Its recorded digest and historical references are retained, not relabeled as verified current bytes. The archived predecessor and approved alias/mapping expansion have independently verified, distinct hashes.

draftDiscrepancy.resolution: Local selection of the supplied companion; retain conflicts and qualify mappings explicitly.

statusDefinitions.implemented: Behavior exists within the stated qualification; not blanket conformance or a current test pass.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some positive behavior exists; the stated remaining acceptance is not met.
statusDefinitions.missing: Positive implementation or required assurance is outstanding; denial does not satisfy it.
statusDefinitions.provider-required: A qualified domain/provider implementation is needed and is not supplied by the base path.
statusDefinitions.upstream-impossible: The named unextended upstream cannot supply the guarantee; the capability rule denies it.
statusDefinitions.excluded: Explicit approved non-goal, not a completed mandatory protocol feature.

capabilities.qualified-core: Built-in transactional provider's bounded model; all writers must share that provider.
capabilities.native-base: Read-only fallback; deny all bridge writes before side effects; never invent zero/touch/atomicity.
capabilities.native-extended: Opt-in generated extension and qualified provider; not part of the published native binding.
capabilities.http-qualified: Authoritative HTTP semantics require deployment qualification, not just a version label.
capabilities.http-prepared: HTTP frontend writes require real remote prepare, complete response preflight and guarded commit.
capabilities.model-provider: Only registered, lossless model/resolution/validation behavior may be enabled or advertised.
capabilities.query-provider: Flags, routes, cursors and OPTIONS must agree with actual supported behavior and caller rights.
capabilities.sync-safe: Confirmed baseline and complete current scope; guarded writes; hold unavailable compound guarantees.
capabilities.durable-local: One qualified local writer; durability and replay cannot be inferred from atomic replacement.
capabilities.caller-isolated: Authenticated inbound identity is distinct from upstream credentials and endpoint selection.
capabilities.host: One selected mode/pair per process; direct construction and DI must share lifecycle behavior.
capabilities.release: Executed, current release evidence and external approvals, not build-only proxies.
capabilities.ledger: Traceability only; structural tests do not establish protocol conformance.
capabilities.excluded: Approved initial-scope exclusion; do not advertise the excluded guarantee.

requirements.requirement: Epoch zero, absent and null preconditions
expected: Zero matches only zero; stale zero returns mismatched_epoch/400 without change.
Absent and null epoch permit an update at a nonzero current epoch.
requirements.qualification: Transactional provider; native-base restrictions are separate rows.

requirements.requirement: Creation ignores supplied epoch
expected: A create carrying epoch 99 succeeds; its first subsequent epoch guard uses the server value.
requirements.qualification: Literal zero/+1 values pin provider policy, not a spec-mandated initial value or step.

requirements.requirement: Identical PUT and empty PATCH touch
expected: Successful identical and empty updates advance epoch and modifiedat, retaining createdat and name.
An existing child update leaves the parent's membership epoch unchanged.
requirements.qualification: Injected clock and provider counters; ordinary native Close retains native semantics.

requirements.requirement: Parent epochs follow immediate membership
expected: Group/resource/version additions and removals change their immediate parent's epoch.
Updates to an existing descendant do not make root or group epochs recursive watermarks.
requirements.qualification: Provider zero-initialized, once-per-request increments are an explicit fixture policy.

requirements.requirement: Resource Meta and Version epochs stay separate
expected: Version edits touch Version epoch only; version membership touches meta.epoch.
Resource deletion checks meta.epoch, not the default Version's top-level epoch.
requirements.qualification: Qualified provider; native role mapping needs its own adapter evidence.

requirements.requirement: Failed compound writes are atomic
expected: A later stale sibling rejects the entire nested write with mismatched_epoch/400.
Original root/group/version metadata, exact bytes and membership survive; no new sibling is published.
requirements.qualification: One authoritative provider transaction, not compensating adapter calls.

requirements.requirement: Full replacement, PATCH null and nested attribute rules
expected: PUT/POST replace mutable attributes; PATCH retains missing attributes and deletes explicit null.
Non-collection complex values replace as units; required/default/read-only rules still apply.
requirements.qualification: Replacement, null deletion, protected/default and conditional attributes are validated against the final candidate before publication.

requirements.requirement: Omitted document versus explicitly empty document
expected: Metadata PATCH without a document preserves 00 FF 01 02; an explicit empty raw body replaces it.
Raw document metadata has PATCH semantics and absent Content-Type removes contenttype.
requirements.qualification: Supported local document forms; remote document resolution is a separate incomplete feature.

requirements.requirement: Documentless versus zero-length document representation
expected: hasdocument=false returns metadata without a document body.
A document-backed resource created without content has a present zero-length document.
requirements.qualification: Internal absent-body representation is ByteString.Null, never Nullable<ByteString>.

requirements.requirement: Missing entities are not successful empty documents
expected: A missing resource returns not_found/404 with no body.
An existing empty document remains 200 with a present zero-length body and unchanged membership.
requirements.qualification: Provider errors, not infrastructure failures converted into empty state.

requirements.requirement: Unsigned epoch width without truncation
expected: Preserve unsigned epochs including zero and values above UInt32; reject mismatches without wrapping.
requirements.qualification: Extended guards and metadata retain arbitrary-width unsigned epochs; companion UInt32 values reject unrepresentable counters instead of narrowing.

requirements.requirement: Response-generation failure cannot commit a mutation
expected: Validate actual frontend metadata, headers and body limits before commit; failure aborts the lease.
requirements.qualification: Real prepared endpoint only; ordinary HTTP is not promoted to a prepared remote backend.

requirements.requirement: Entity timestamp write and membership semantics
requirements.section: Entity Attributes: createdat Attribute; modifiedat Attribute
expected: Omitting createdat preserves the existing value; null resets it and an explicit timestamp replaces it.
Absent, null or equal modifiedat uses the request time; a different explicit timestamp is retained.
Child creation and deletion update the immediate parent's modifiedat; descendant edits do not.
Apply the same rules to the Registry, Groups, Resource Meta and Versions without changing incarnations.
requirements.qualification: The transactional provider uses one request timestamp and compares canonical UTC values.

expected: Return root identity/model-driven collections; process full or partial root updates atomically.
requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

Return only the processed nested collections/entities.

requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.requirement: Registry export

requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.requirement: Configured /.xregistry discovery
expected: Expose configured registry discovery using the pinned shape and configured public roots.
requirements.qualification: Configured absolute registry URLs are published without contacting their targets.

requirements.requirement: OPTIONS and advertised action agreement
expected: No mutation; Allow and Access-Control-Allow-Methods agree, include OPTIONS and honor caller rights.
requirements.qualification: OPTIONS matches supported actions and caller rights without creating missing entities.

requirements.requirement: Disallowed collection PUT and standalone Meta DELETE
expected: Reject forbidden actions with action_not_supported/405, no side effects and a truthful Allow.
requirements.qualification: Collection PUT and independent Meta deletion are not advertised or dispatched.

expected: Normal URLs return raw documents where modeled; $details returns metadata; no ?meta alias.

requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.requirement: Raw-document header metadata uses PATCH semantics
requirements.section: Creating or Updating Entities; HTTP-Specific Attribute Processing Rules
expected: Omitted metadata survives raw PUT; absent Content-Type deletes contenttype while bytes are replaced.
requirements.qualification: Provider-level literal oracle; complete header codec conformance remains separate.

requirements.requirement: Header exclusions, escaping and empty metadata bodies
requirements.section: Creating or Updating Entities; HTTP Header Values
expected: Reject extra xRegistry headers on metadata-body writes and forbidden document headers.
Distinguish missing metadata body from {}; preserve exact pinned header escaping/null forms.
requirements.qualification: Header typing resolves active/nested conditional definitions independently of header order; invalid or ambiguous values reject before commit, and metadata-body representation retains unsupported compound header shapes.

requirements.requirement: Success status, changed maps and public links
expected: Create returns 201 with Location=self; update returns 200 without Location.
Content-Location selects the exact Version; collection responses contain only changed entries.
requirements.qualification: Literal provider-backed HTTP cases cover the supported route verbs and persistence, collection response subsets, metadata POST status, default selection and public-root rebasing; raw and query interactions have separate binding/provider oracles.

requirements.requirement: Pinned errors and Problem Details
expected: mismatched_epoch is 400; action_not_supported is 405 with Allow; do not invent 409/412.
Preserve operation-specific errors; Problem Details JSON is recommended, not a mandatory schema invention.
requirements.qualification: Failure responses retain pinned problem fields and method advertisement; non-encodable mutation responses abort before publication.

requirements.requirement: xregistry-root Link on all responses
expected: Success and error responses identify the configured public root with rel=xregistry-root.
requirements.qualification: The binding emits its configured xregistry-root Link on every response it prepares; transport failures before HTTP response construction cannot emit headers.

requirements.requirement: Redirects and shortself
expected: Preserve spec-defined redirects and identity lifetimes; do not fetch another origin with credentials.
requirements.qualification: The opt-in transactional catalog explicitly initializes format 2 and owns persistent, never-reused aliases for each entity role. Same-caller resolution precedes shape decoding, canonical authorization and atomic address revalidation; dispatch never redirects writes. Replays retain the original alias digest after retirement. Ordinary HTTP requires an explicitly qualified immutable-alias/doc profile and gains no remote preparation or journal.

requirements.requirement: ETag, Range, compression and link-parameter classification
expected: Classify these HTTP facilities from primary requirements before implementing or excluding them.
requirements.qualification: Pinned HTTP/core semantics require no ETag or Range service. Unsupported validators reject before mutation; ignored Range returns the complete 200 representation. Bounded gzip/deflate decoding and standard pagination count/Expires are supported without invented compression or validators.

requirements.requirement: inline selects exact dot-notation paths
expected: Expand only requested paths, including escaped names, rather than any matching path segment.
requirements.qualification: Exact model-relative paths and only terminal whole-segment wildcards control inlining.

requirements.requirement: filter grammar and matching
expected: Evaluate pinned filter grammar, typed comparisons and collection scope before shaping a response.
requirements.qualification: Bounded dot paths, typed comparisons, wildcard values, OR/AND pruning and recomputed counts.

requirements.requirement: sort grammar and ordering
expected: Apply requested ordering with pinned field/path semantics and retain it across pages.
requirements.qualification: Scalar keys, same-direction ID ties and consistent ordering across opaque continuation pages.

requirements.requirement: doc and inline document forms
expected: Select correct JSON/string/base64 document forms without changing authoritative bytes.
requirements.qualification: Document view omits default duplication, retains metadata, and uses JSON-pointer navigation only for inlined targets.

requirements.requirement: binary representation selection
expected: Honor binary selection according to the flag and requested representation, not a static advert.
requirements.qualification: Binary controls document representation without independently enabling inline content.

requirements.requirement: collections-only response
expected: Registry/Group collections selection returns named collection maps only; invalid targets cannot commit.
requirements.qualification: Collections-only responses implicitly inline descendants while omitting owning-entity attributes.

requirements.requirement: ignore processing
expected: Apply only supported ignore rules and expose the actual supported ignores in capabilities.
requirements.qualification: Ignore processing is entity-aware; nested opaque domain fields and readonly sources are not accidentally erased.

requirements.requirement: Deletion epoch query guard
expected: Use the query guard at its target, preserve zero/null semantics, reject malformed guards atomically.
requirements.qualification: Qualified provider deletion path only.

requirements.requirement: specversion selection
expected: Select supported protocol representations; unsupported selection cannot mutate.
Do not confuse specversion, NamespaceVersion and entity versionid.
requirements.qualification: Specification comparison ignores patch versions but retains case-insensitive RC suffix identity.

requirements.requirement: setdefaultversionid request flag
expected: Apply default-version selection with its pinned mutation, sticky and response semantics.
requirements.qualification: Atomic default selection accompanies deletion/creation and overrides body defaults; null/request have distinct semantics.

requirements.requirement: Unknown and unsupported query flags
expected: Ignore unknown/unsupported query parameters rather than blanket-rejecting them.
requirements.qualification: Unknown extension flags remain ignored; known malformed flags fail before side effects.

requirements.requirement: Full flag interaction and response preflight matrix
expected: Combine inline/filter/sort/doc/binary/collections/ignore/epoch/specversion/default selection safely.
requirements.qualification: Known flag validation and actual response shaping precede publication, including actions with bodyless responses.

requirements.requirement: Pinned pagination grammar
requirements.section: Client Request; Server Response; HTTP Binding
expected: Honor positive UInt64 limit, opaque Link navigation, next/prev boundaries, expires and stable count.
Do not assume offset is normative; the pin is explicitly 0.1-wip.
requirements.qualification: Opaque continuation context is restored before reference expansion or blob hydration; caller, generation, view, offsets and expiry survive every view clone.

requirements.requirement: Generation- and caller-bound cursor safety
expected: Bind bounded cursors to generation, caller, model, path and query; release on expiry/cancellation.
Never expose raw OPC UA continuation points as HTTP cursors.
requirements.qualification: Authenticated stateless cursors bind caller/session/roles, path, view, original parameters, generation and expiration.

requirements.requirement: Adapters consume actual pinned pagination links
requirements.section: HTTP Binding / Iterating over the record set
expected: Follow opaque server links unchanged, enforce endpoint policy and report interrupted scans incomplete.
requirements.qualification: Adapters preserve returned opaque continuation grammar and local document-view pointers without requiring callers to reconstruct flags.

requirements.requirement: Model-defined collection identities and colliding local IDs
expected: Keep multiple group/resource plural/singular names and full collection-aware identities.
Equal local IDs in different collections must not alias; preserve Unicode and escaped IDs exactly.
requirements.qualification: Logical paths retain collection type identity and escaped IDs even when native local IDs collide; ambiguous base create methods reject rather than select an arbitrary type.

requirements.requirement: Typed extension values and nested structures
expected: Preserve modeled JSON scalar/array/object values and nested attributes without stringifying them.
requirements.qualification: Declared built-in types and the experimental transport; base AttributesType is not lossless.

requirements.requirement: Defaults, required, read-only and immutable attributes
expected: Apply defaults at creation, enforce required/immutable rules and correctly ignore read-only writes.
requirements.qualification: Required/default/readonly behavior and protected standard definitions are validated before publication.

requirements.requirement: Conditional ifvalues and siblingattributes
expected: Apply conditional sibling definitions and their nested defaults/constraints for each matching value.
requirements.qualification: Case-insensitive conditional activation includes active sibling definitions; conflicts and stale attributes reject atomically.

requirements.requirement: Typed xid/url target constraints
expected: Resolve target types and references without lossy strings, cycles or unconstrained network access.
requirements.qualification: Model-typed URI/XID targets validate structural type shape; target existence is not invented.

requirements.requirement: ximportresources and $include(s)
requirements.section: Reuse of Resource Definitions; Includes in the xRegistry Model Data
expected: Resolve imported/included definitions with source/effective separation, cycle and quota checks.
requirements.qualification: Local imports and bounded approved includes preserve source/effective separation and imported type identity.

requirements.requirement: Content-type typemap semantics
expected: Apply declared content-type mappings consistently to qualified resolution and validation.
requirements.qualification: Default/custom media mappings choose JSON, text or exact base64; conflicting mappings use binary.

requirements.requirement: Group constraint defaults
expected: Apply group-specific constraint defaults as well as enum and equality constraints.
requirements.qualification: Group defaults override resource defaults and cannot widen constraints or target dynamic/non-scalar paths.

requirements.requirement: Group constraint enum and equality validation
expected: Enforce declared enum/equality constraints across modeled/instance values without partial writes.
requirements.qualification: Model and instance constraints validate all affected Versions, including referenced views.

requirements.requirement: matchversions completeness
expected: Enforce declared cross-Version equality, including nested values and changes to live model rules.
requirements.qualification: Static versioned scalar matching is evaluated after final counters and includes nested object paths.

requirements.requirement: Live schema-change validation
requirements.section: Creating or Updating the Registry Model
expected: Accept compatible model updates; reject any whole-model change that invalidates retained entities.
requirements.qualification: Model and entity changes share one candidate; incompatible remaining data causes rollback.

requirements.requirement: setversionid and server-assigned Versions
expected: Honor explicit-ID permission; allocate collision-free IDs and return the actual identity.
requirements.qualification: Server assignment is explicit, semver-compatible where configured, and stronger sync paths retain returned identity.

requirements.requirement: maxversions retention completeness
expected: Honor zero/unlimited and bounded retention without losing the protected default or ancestry.
requirements.qualification: Retention respects default/ancestry rules; prepared synchronization rejects unexpected pruning effects.

requirements.requirement: Manual, createdat and modifiedat ordering
expected: Select the correct default and ancestry for each advertised manual/createdat/modifiedat mode.
requirements.qualification: Automatic ordering and ancestry are finalized together; ordering timestamps remain meaningful for reconciliation.

requirements.requirement: Semantic Version ordering
expected: Order permitted semantic Versions and choose ancestry/default/retention consistently.
requirements.qualification: Strict SemVer 2.0 parsing and arbitrary-width numeric precedence; build metadata does not change precedence.

requirements.requirement: singleversionroot and ancestry integrity
expected: Enforce configured roots and valid ancestry when creating, deleting, rerooting and retaining Versions.
requirements.qualification: Root/cycle/deleted-ancestor rules and ordering-driven reparenting preserve epoch/timestamp semantics.

requirements.requirement: Default and sticky Version selection
expected: Keep the selected sticky default while retaining Versions; ordinary default selection follows its mode.
requirements.qualification: Local Meta operations; request selection flags and sync closures have separate incomplete rows.

requirements.requirement: Cross-reference Resources
expected: Resolve xref Resources, preserve identity and apply bounded cycle/type/authorization checks.
requirements.qualification: Local xrefs require actual shared model-type provenance; inaccessible/transitive targets do not invent Versions.

requirements.requirement: External document references
expected: Preserve permitted document URL/reference semantics and exact content without uncontrolled fetching.
requirements.qualification: External documents retain exact URI references without fetch across reads, guarded synchronization, URI changes and conversion back to local bytes.

requirements.requirement: Domain format validation
expected: Run registered format validators and advertise only actually supported formats.
requirements.qualification: Injectable validators; built-in JSON/1.0 and XML/1.0 syntax only, not generic schema validation.

requirements.requirement: Domain compatibility validation
expected: Apply registered compatibility algorithms against the correct ancestry/document set.
requirements.qualification: Injectable compatibility validation; the built-in identical mode requires exact format/document equality.

requirements.requirement: Strict validation and stored validation outcomes
expected: Distinguish valid/invalid/unknown validation and preserve the required results/reasons atomically.
requirements.qualification: Unknown/external checks retain explicit unvalidated reasons or reject in strict mode; invalid checked data always rejects.

requirements.requirement: Lossless modelsource versus effective model across modes
expected: Never fabricate modelsource from the effective model; carry resolved/source distinctions end to end.
requirements.qualification: Source/effective model separation survives restart and transport; independently resolvable extensions can synchronize.

requirements.requirement: Logical Resource, Meta and exact Version native roles
expected: Keep a logical Resource/default view separate from Versions and Resource Meta.
Resource deletion uses MetaEpoch; Version deletion uses that Version's epoch.
requirements.qualification: Runtime hierarchy discovery preserves logical/Meta/exact-Version roles; legacy missing default identity is explicit rather than manufactured.

requirements.requirement: Base native explicit-zero guard cannot emulate HTTP
requirements.section: 4.3. Entity processing rules; 4.5. Method signatures and argument mapping
expected: Deny base-adapter writes before effects; zero cannot be translated into unconditional ExpectedEpoch.
requirements.qualification: An unextended ExpectedEpoch=0 disables the native check.
requirements.remaining: Full HTTP zero fidelity requires the opted-in stronger endpoint, not a client read/check/write.

requirements.requirement: Base clean Close cannot supply HTTP identical-write touch
requirements.section: Native OPC UA requirements and representation gaps
expected: Keep native clean/byte-identical Close behavior; do not claim it advances HTTP update counters.
requirements.qualification: HTTP touch is an explicit extended operation, not an altered base FileType contract.
requirements.remaining: No positive full HTTP write claim on unextended servers.

requirements.requirement: Multiple base Calls/Writes cannot make an HTTP transaction
expected: Reject compound/conditional/touch writes before any effect on an unextended native backend.
requirements.qualification: A client lock, compensating calls or a bulk_atomic=false flag cannot waive HTTP atomic failure.
requirements.remaining: Use real qualified native preparation for full writes; no unsafe fallback.

requirements.requirement: Base UInt32 projection cannot represent arbitrary wide epochs
expected: Never cast/wrap a wider source epoch into UInt32; report an unrepresentable base projection.
requirements.qualification: Base scalar UInt32 remains a hard limit; extended JSON and guards retain full integers.
requirements.remaining: Unextended base writes remain unavailable; no narrowing fallback is permitted.

requirements.requirement: Collection-type disambiguation in native create methods
expected: Use a discovered domain mapping or extension to address multiple modeled collections unambiguously.
requirements.qualification: The extended path identifies collection types losslessly; selector-less base create methods explicitly reject multi-collection ambiguity.

requirements.requirement: Typed native domain attribute mapping
expected: Map typed JSON through a qualified domain adapter or extension; do not stringify into AttributesType.
requirements.qualification: Explicit model-driven, namespace-URI profiles map canonical String Properties and typed scalars, arrays or registered field-accessible structures without flattening labels. Conditional values are independent of field/profile order; precision, presence, native metadata, caller permissions and precommit quotas are enforced. Existing WoT exact-Version mappings are supported without inventing absent root metadata. Unmapped/unsupported structures and unextended HTTP mutations remain explicit limitations, not inferred capabilities.

requirements.requirement: Raw optional Model/Capabilities and offered/source data
requirements.section: 5.4. Reading capabilities and model documents; 5.5. Updating capabilities
expected: Preserve raw optional JSON documents; CapabilitiesInfo is not the full HTTP capability model.
requirements.qualification: The qualified extension retains original/effective model, offered/active capabilities, typed metadata and exact/default Version roles; optional unextended layouts are read only and absent operations remain explicit.

requirements.requirement: Actual old/new hierarchy discovery
requirements.section: Behavioral contract / Model, identity and discovery
expected: Probe actual nodes, types and methods; preserve older sibling Version files rather than inventing history.
requirements.qualification: Read-only fallback inspects actual nodes; namespace labels and communication failures never substitute for discovery evidence.

requirements.requirement: Namespace/model/reconnect mapping recovery
expected: Resolve namespace URIs and TypeDefinitions; rebuild proxies, maps and subscriptions after changes.
requirements.qualification: Namespace-URI identity is re-resolved and old model/connection subscriptions terminate for full repair.

requirements.requirement: Consistent multi-call inventory generations
expected: Reject torn metadata/document/membership scans and recheck the generation before accepting the inventory.
ExpectedGeneration and returned Generation are optional format-1 fields gated by SupportsGenerationGuards.
Apply guards across continuation pages, without retained leases, automatic retries or narrowed epoch counters.
Restart and changed loaded state expire tokens; unextended HTTP/native must reject explicit guards.
requirements.qualification: Generation-checked inventories and staged service visibility prevent mixed/uncommitted native views.

requirements.requirement: Version incarnation fencing
expected: Fence delete/recreate with identical epochs/timestamps, both before Close and across dispatch boundaries.
ExpectedVersionIncarnation and VersionIncarnation remain optional codec-format-1 request/response fields.
SupportsVersionIncarnationGuards is an optional format-1 description flag, false when absent.
Persist random Version incarnations; legacy guards are bound to exact loaded bytes until persisted.
Validate guards atomically; writable native Open needs advertised support and a returned incarnation.
Close passes the pinned guard without a separate createdat read; unsupported guards fail before dispatch.
requirements.qualification: Explicit Version paths on the transactional provider and negotiated native transport; ordinary HTTP denies guards.

requirements.requirement: Projection prepared before local authoritative publication
expected: Prepare response/projection/events before local commit; externally committed failures report degraded state.
requirements.qualification: Candidate projection, response resources and events are prepared before local commit; failed CAS restores pinned handles.

requirements.requirement: Real remote preparation and immutable response preview
requirements.section: Full-fidelity native writes and the optional extension
expected: Stage without publication; preview actual output; commit once at the guarded generation or abort.
requirements.qualification: Experimental extension with shared authoritative provider and caller-owned bounded leases.

requirements.requirement: Operation replay, digest and durable outcome lookup
requirements.section: Full-fidelity native writes and the optional extension
expected: Same ID/digest cannot apply twice; changed payload under the same ID fails; uncertain outcomes stay distinct.
requirements.qualification: Durable provider outcomes are caller-scoped; acknowledgment retains replay barriers and unknown creation never retries.

requirements.requirement: Write-through gateway and session-pinned file lifecycle
expected: Commit against the authoritative backend before success; native chunks stage until successful Close.
Handles belong to their session and exact Version across default changes; clean Close must not touch.
Writable Open requires advertised and returned incarnation; read-only access remains available without it.
Close forwards the incarnation guard atomically, not a separate createdat read/check/write sequence.
requirements.qualification: Writes remain authoritative and session/incarnation pinned; late work retains resources until safe cleanup.

requirements.requirement: Commit-coupled native event emission
expected: Emit correctly scoped committed events with final counters; failed/replayed commits do not duplicate events.
requirements.qualification: Existing coalescer/generated events are commit-coupled; rejection and replay cannot emit duplicate mutation batches.

requirements.requirement: Native event invalidation, overflow and reconnect repair
expected: Treat optional native events as invalidation hints and reconcile after loss/overflow/reconnect.
requirements.qualification: Bounded coalesced hints trigger complete repair; periodic scans remain authoritative.

requirements.requirement: Optional operation/event correlation
expected: When emitted, correlate response/events and return xRegistry-xregcorrelationid over HTTP.
Do not require arbitrary upstreams to accept a caller-chosen ID or use correlation alone to prevent echoes.
requirements.qualification: Native events carry only correlation returned by the same authoritative interaction; changed prepared/commit correlation degrades notifications without changing a known mutation outcome.

requirements.requirement: Experimental generated extension, not a rewritten binding
requirements.section: Confirmed scope and decisions; Full-fidelity native writes
expected: Negotiate opted-in generated extension types in a separate namespace; preserve base callers and IDs.
requirements.qualification: An experimental extension is not a new published xRegistry or companion specification.

requirements.requirement: Three-way reconciliation in both directions
expected: Compare baseline/current native/current HTTP state; merge supported one-sided edits and verify convergence.
requirements.qualification: Qualified simple metadata/document/version profile only, not model/reference closures.

requirements.requirement: Manual/prefer-opcua/prefer-http conflict policies
requirements.section: Confirmed scope and decisions; Two-way synchronization
expected: Handle first-run collisions and both-changed baselines; manual is safe default; preference is not clock LWW.
requirements.qualification: Supported entity profile; dependency-closure conflict propagation remains incomplete.

requirements.requirement: Guarded deletions on by default and --deletes off
requirements.section: Confirmed scope and decisions; Two-way synchronization
expected: Propagate deletion only with baseline, confirmed absence, stable scope and current destination guards.
Disabling deletes keeps the survivor and baseline; no unguarded-delete mode exists.
requirements.qualification: Subtree/Version deletes use qualified prepared destinations, not ordinary HTTP assumptions.

requirements.requirement: Incomplete or unauthorized observations never imply deletion
expected: Timeout, access loss, partial scans or concurrent destination edits cannot authorize destructive propagation.
requirements.qualification: Existing scope is held while independently safe updates can proceed.

requirements.requirement: Intent before mutation, outcome before baseline
expected: Persist intent before sending; save verified outcome before advancing baseline; never blindly retry PUT.
requirements.qualification: Qualified persisted state and supported mutation profile.

requirements.requirement: No-op convergence and echo suppression
expected: Persist fingerprints/outcomes so identical convergence causes no write or epoch churn.
Ignore backend-generated counters/timestamps/links as replicated content; do not depend on correlation IDs.
requirements.qualification: Polling/simple entities; repeated native-event handling remains an incomplete separate feature.

requirements.requirement: Model-first reconciliation
expected: Reconcile compatible modelsource before dependent entities; explicit conflicts for destructive changes.
requirements.qualification: Compatible independently verifiable model extensions are persisted before dependent entities; destructive migrations remain explicit.

requirements.requirement: Reference/default dependency closures
expected: Create referenced resources/documents/exact Versions before dependent defaults and references.
requirements.qualification: Reference/default dependencies use prepared closures when needed; manual unlimited Versions can copy their external document URI through the existing guarded metadata path without fetching it.

requirements.requirement: Server-assigned identity correspondence
expected: Persist actual source/destination ID mapping with outcome evidence; ambiguous creates stay held.
requirements.qualification: Exact Version correspondence translates model-typed references through objects/maps/arrays without reparenting existing JSON children; opaque siblings remain unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Protected metadata, ancestry, ordering and retention sync
expected: Reconcile qualified ancestry/default/retention closures and protected attributes losslessly.
requirements.qualification: Qualified prepared closures preserve ordering/default/retention dependencies; independently protected domain mappings stay provider-specific.

requirements.requirement: Recovery at every durable boundary
expected: Recover without duplicate versions, lost edits or discarded losing observations after each durable boundary.
requirements.qualification: Intents, response evidence, identity mappings and restored pending outcomes remain durable and no-retry.

requirements.requirement: Ordinary HTTP cannot provide remote prepared subtree guards
expected: Hold unsafe compound deletions/ambiguous creates if the remote cannot prove required guards and outcome.
requirements.qualification: The synchronizer holds changes requiring missing subtree preparation and protects concurrent descendants/default selection. Ordinary HTTP adds neither remote prepare nor an operation journal; qualified prepared destinations enable the stronger closure path.

requirements.requirement: Independent counters, clocks and deployment identity
expected: Retain each side's epochs locally; do not compare their numeric values or replicate generated identity.
Registry identity, deployment capabilities and credentials are not synchronized entity content.
requirements.qualification: Canonical client-meaningful content comparison within the supported profile.

requirements.requirement: Full repair must observe leaves, not only parent epochs
expected: Periodic complete inventories inspect descendant Version/Meta changes even when parent epochs are unchanged.
requirements.qualification: Hints never authorize absence; full scans still inspect leaf changes and revalidate generation/membership.

requirements.requirement: Memory and restart-safe file providers
expected: Persist metadata, bytes, identities, outcomes and baselines with qualified publication/durability.
requirements.qualification: Local single-writer stores, not active/active or eventual shared-store guarantees.

requirements.requirement: Corrupt/missing initialized state fails closed
expected: Corruption, unsupported formats, missing markers or uncertain durability never mean pristine empty state.
requirements.qualification: Missing/corrupt committed state or content fails closed; restore cannot overwrite initialized evidence.

requirements.requirement: State/document/lease quotas and publication faults
expected: Enforce before/at/after limits; failed staging/flush/replace never acknowledges uncertain publication.
requirements.qualification: Prepared/count/memory/disk/content limits reject before publication; failed spool writes cannot commit partial data.

requirements.requirement: Validated backup, recovery and versioned migration
expected: Provide read-only inspection, validated restoration and explicit versioned state migrations.
requirements.qualification: Offline status/backup/restore reuse validated durable state; format-1 migration retains recovery evidence and only pristine destinations may be initialized.

requirements.requirement: Acknowledged-progress compaction and replay retirement
expected: Retire tombstones/journals only after both-side progress with no pending dependency.
Retired IDs must never be accepted as fresh; no arbitrary seven-day expiry or resurrection.
requirements.qualification: CLI and library compaction require exact-generation explicit acknowledgments and retain baselines, sequence, tombstones and unresolved evidence.

requirements.requirement: Bounded streaming/spooling and blob-reference publication
expected: Stream/spool large content under memory/disk quotas and atomically publish immutable blob references.
requirements.qualification: Streamed immutable blobs publish before metadata CAS; native spill files have separate memory/disk reservations.

requirements.requirement: Large transfer, seek, interrupted upload and handle cleanup
expected: Preserve binary bytes and random access beyond message limits; cancel/release session-owned transfers.
requirements.qualification: Seekable native handles reclaim owned spools and reservations on completion, interruption and retirement.

requirements.requirement: Single-writer ownership and qualified storage consistency
expected: Reject a second local writer; do not infer HA fencing or power-loss durability from atomic replace alone.
requirements.qualification: Implemented local-writer profile only; a shared adapter must separately qualify consistency.

requirements.requirement: Inbound authorization is independent of operator credentials
expected: Require trusted authenticated inbound context; an operator profile or spoofed header grants no rights.
requirements.qualification: Current operator-scope host, not genuine per-caller upstream endpoint selection.

requirements.requirement: Navigation/root policy prevents credential forwarding
expected: Reject cross-origin/root/userinfo escapes and never forward arbitrary caller authentication upstream.
requirements.qualification: HTTP navigation policy; future model/reference resolution must reuse it.

requirements.requirement: Actual per-caller endpoint/session lease resolution
expected: Inject caller-specific HTTP clients or ManagedSessions with isolated upstream visibility and rights.
requirements.qualification: Real per-caller resolver leases span inspection/preparation/commit; no shared upstream token or model cache is added.

requirements.requirement: Caller-isolated caches, projections, cursors and transfers
expected: One caller cannot observe or reuse another caller's data, sessions, cursor or transfer leases.
requirements.qualification: Caller/session/role ownership fences cursors and leases; different native visibility scopes use separate manager instances.

requirements.requirement: Named credential profiles and existing identity providers
expected: Use named profiles and secret/token/certificate providers for anonymous/user/X509/issued identities.
requirements.qualification: Direct/DI runtime policies use secret-backed usernames, managed certificate validation and trusted JWT/JWKS. No anonymous policy is enabled by native connector configuration.

requirements.requirement: Trust, token/certificate rotation and revocation
expected: Use HTTPS/SignAndEncrypt with validated trust and rotate/revoke identities without persisting secrets.
requirements.qualification: Live secret/expiry/revocation checks and managed certificate validation precede operations; credentials are not persisted.

requirements.requirement: Reusable options/factory/runner and thin executable
expected: Move reusable endpoint resolution, mode lifecycle and polling from the CLI into the injectable library.
requirements.qualification: The selected mode gates dependencies; a gateway cannot silently resolve or execute an unrelated synchronization job.

requirements.requirement: Direct/DI/fluent async typed AOT-safe construction
expected: Preserve provider seams, generated clients, TAP, typed ArrayOf/ByteString APIs and dependency direction.
requirements.qualification: Direct and DI use the same TAP/typed/generated implementation; native-published execution covers both gateways and sync.

requirements.requirement: CLI modes, inspection, once/dry-run, conflicts and resolution
expected: Expose mode/pair/profile/state/public-root options and nonmutating inspection, dry-run and conflict listing.
requirements.qualification: All selected deployment and offline administration commands are implemented. Native CLI readiness waits for actual IServerStartupTask completion and a healthy projection; startup failure returns failure rather than ready or normal shutdown.

requirements.requirement: Complete all-mode readiness, status and lag
expected: Report upstream/guarantees/scan completeness/lag/pending outcomes/conflicts/storage/spool/degraded state.
requirements.qualification: Status exposes readiness, lag, last success, reconciliation counts and optional native memory/disk/handle reservations.

requirements.requirement: Source-generated telemetry, audit and redaction
expected: Audit caller/job/target/outcome via existing telemetry/redaction, without tokens or document contents.
requirements.qualification: Source-generated audit records preserve operation outcome and configured redaction while excluding payloads and credentials; real host inspection errors retain actionable status.

requirements.requirement: Option validation, bounded stop, deadlines and cleanup
expected: Reject invalid options before listeners/state writes; propagate shutdown and release resources after use.
requirements.qualification: Deadlines bound waiting without releasing active pass/lease ownership. Host teardown waits for actual work or defers owned disposal; legacy wait helpers retain source cancellation rather than misclassify it as timeout.

requirements.requirement: Existing xRegistry/WoT/PubSub/AI consumer compatibility
expected: Retain existing callers and domain behavior; optional interfaces/extensions stay optional.
requirements.qualification: Current Windows validation covers the full solution builds, xRegistry/WoT/PubSub/notification compatibility selection, modern AI consumers, and all-mode NativeAOT. The sole initial fixture-hash failure was unchanged LF-pinned checkout content normalized without a source diff.

requirements.requirement: All library TFMs and modern/mixed host matrix
expected: Execute supported tests on net10/net48 and mixed netstandard2.1-library/net8-consumer builds.
Modern hosting must remain exercised on Windows/Linux and supported modern TFMs.
requirements.qualification: All six declared library TFMs compile and package with matching dependencies. Matching net8/net9/net10 hosted paths and net472/net48/actual-netstandard2.1 portable consumers execute their applicable suites; portable host exclusions are not claimed as hosted-path execution.

requirements.requirement: Actual NativeAOT execution of both gateways and sync
requirements.section: Validation and acceptance / Runtime and delivery
expected: Publish and execute native binaries through both gateway mutations and synchronization scenarios.
requirements.qualification: The Windows native PE has no CLR header and executes both gateways and durable synchronization; the actual native connector also performs real HTTP inspection and offline state commands.
requirements.remaining: Hosted Linux/NativeAOT execution requires a Linux runtime or authorized CI publication; no Docker Linux daemon or usable local Linux distribution is available.

requirements.requirement: Clean local tool/package installation and payload
expected: Install from a clean local feed/output, launch the packaged tool and inspect all TFM/dependency payloads.
requirements.qualification: The locally packed tool was installed from an isolated feed and executed for help, pristine state status and invalid compaction; all five xRegistry library packages retain six framework assemblies/dependency groups. Receipts and commands are release artifacts, not a public conformance certificate.

requirements.requirement: Independent behavior fixtures and coverage/diagnostic gates
expected: Use independent literal oracles, real encrypted native sessions and independent HTTP fixtures.
Preserve coverage; new non-test projects meet 80% and configured gates with clean diagnostics.
requirements.qualification: Independent literal state/wire/lifecycle cases pass. All four new package line floors exceed 80%; correctly source-root-mapped changed-line coverage exceeds the 75% large-patch gate even pessimistically counting uninstrumented shared helper lines as uncovered. Owned active diagnostics are clean; untouched solution warnings remain explicitly attributed.

requirements.requirement: Current required CI and attributed baseline failures
expected: Fix branch-caused failures and separately reproduce true baseline/environment failures.
requirements.qualification: Full current Windows net10 and mixed-library solution builds succeed; the original mixed-TFM source defect is fixed. Remote CodeQL and CLA checks pass on the old draft head.
requirements.remaining: The remote Linux-all-TFM and required summary checks still target 94d5fa1ad, not these unpushed changes. Rerunning current hosted CI requires authorized publication.

requirements.requirement: Maintainer design sign-off, review and CLA
expected: Obtain external architectural sign-off and required review/CLA; local approval is not GitHub sign-off.
requirements.qualification: The existing draft has a successful license/cla check; maintainer architectural approval and required review are still external.
requirements.remaining: Maintainers must approve the design in issue #4467 and review the updated draft. Continuing publication is not authorized; no push, merge or draft-state change is performed.

requirements.requirement: Current rollout, migration and operational documentation
expected: Keep qualified profiles, direct/DI examples, recovery rules, limits and immutable pins consistent.
requirements.qualification: Bridge, DI, package and tool documentation describe current qualification, explicit credentials, quotas, native limits, state migration/restore, real readiness and deferred shutdown ownership.

requirements.requirement: Distinct write-through gateways and actual synchronization
expected: Gateways await their authority; sync reconciles independently writable registries as a separate mode.
requirements.qualification: One selected mode and registry pair per process; only the qualified feature profile is delivered.

requirements.requirement: No default active/active replication
expected: Use one active synchronization writer per job; do not claim default active/active safety.
requirements.qualification: State/ownership remain injectable for separately qualified deployments.
requirements.remaining: Explicit original-scope non-goal, not completed distributed replication.

requirements.requirement: No cross-registry distributed transaction or exactly-once promise
requirements.section: Confirmed scope and decisions; State, security and operational behavior
expected: Do not claim cross-registry atomicity/exactly-once delivery from local replay or event timestamps.
requirements.qualification: Prepared local/remote mutations and recoverable reconciliation are narrower guarantees.
requirements.remaining: Explicit non-goal; no invented distributed transaction interface.

requirements.requirement: No unrelated automatic discovery or new event broker
expected: Use configured registry pairs and existing event infrastructure; do not scan unrelated servers.
requirements.qualification: Configured /.xregistry support remains in scope and incomplete.
requirements.remaining: Explicit initial-scope non-goal; configured discovery must not be excluded with it.

requirements.requirement: No arbitrary artifact conversion or new unapproved dependencies
expected: Preserve opaque documents; reuse centrally pinned dependencies instead of converting domain artifacts.
requirements.qualification: A new third-party dependency still needs approval; native models use existing generation tooling.
requirements.remaining: Explicit non-goal; this ledger/oracle change adds no dependency.

requirements.requirement: No invented HTTP watch or guaranteed historical event replay
expected: Poll HTTP and repair from current inventory; do not expose a made-up watch endpoint or durable cursor.
requirements.qualification: Native events are optional; history/durable replay are not guaranteed by the selected binding.
requirements.remaining: Excluded invented guarantees do not excuse missing native invalidation/repair implementation.

requirements.requirement: Pinned machine-readable acceptance and gap ledger
expected: Keep immutable source/section references, original acceptance/gap IDs, statuses and exact test links.
requirements.qualification: The stable 146-ID/45-action ledger resolves exact executable evidence and pinned public/member references without redistributing member text. The unavailable historical plan retains its recorded digest; independently verified predecessor/expansion archives are explicitly not replacements for those bytes. Bookkeeping is not blanket protocol certification.

requirements.requirement: Independent already-implemented core oracles
expected: Execute literal expected provider outcomes for the bounded implemented core without self-roundtrips.
requirements.qualification: Literal independent core oracles execute against the real provider; initial-zero and +1 sequences select documented provider policy rather than redefine the specification.
